QuestInfo.name: Ghost Mansion
QuestInfo.0: Visit one of the Big 3 attractions, the Ghostacular Mansion, at the #m223010100#.\n
QuestInfo.1: Make it all the way through the Ghostacular Mansion without giving up to receive a stamp. Go into the mansion and defeat 50 Ghosts and Rataculas.
QuestInfo.2: There was a real ghost in the Ghostacular Mansion! That white Cuddle Bear seemed really out of place though.

0.0: Welcome to the Ghostacular Mansion! I'm giving away stamps to those brave enough to get to the end of the mansion. Do you have it in you?

1.0: Did you have fun in the Ghostacular Mansion?

yes.0: Hey, look at you! You made it through the Ghostacular Mansion. Don't look at me for that stamp. I'll tell everybody you made it through.
yes.1: I'll be waiting for you at the Gyro Drop. Take your time!

mob.0: Don't be scared. You probably won't lose any limbs. Just go in there, have some fun, and hang out with 50 Ghosts and Rataculas, okay?
